verdict.rationale: Postman's docs index lists first-party Variables and Environments pages (managing-environments), and a community user says it is invaluable for validating APIs across environments. That confirms an environment-variable capability exists. The pack only contains link titles, so the switching workflow itself is not described. missing for 10: documented description of creating environment variable sets and switching the active environment per request, explicit dev/staging/prod workflow evidence, in-depth first-party docs content beyond link titles.

support.subject: As a developer, I can switch requests between dev, staging, and prod using environment variable sets

citations.quote: it's invaluable for testing/validating APIs across environments
